definitions.C1: Knows corporate income tax law within the verification service: taxable income, deductible expenses, incentives and finalisation.
definitions.C2: Re-reads and corrects drafts (including AI drafts): finds what is wrong or missing and fixes it.
definitions.C3: Checks that the client’s information and documents are accurate and sufficient, or asks for more.
definitions.C4: Matches specific provisions to the client’s case and applies them correctly.
definitions.C5: Makes the final verification conclusion and is responsible for it.

C1.PASS: A corporate income tax certificate or course and a tax file prepared or reviewed.
C1.FAIL: Nothing related to corporate income tax.

C2.PASS: A review copy or correction notes showing errors found and fixed.
C2.NEED_MORE_INFORMATION: Only a CV or a description, no file proving it.
C2.FAIL: Files show only own work, never reviewing someone else’s.

C3.PASS: Document check minutes or a checklist with the expert’s comments.

C4.PASS: An opinion or analysis citing the right provisions for a specific case.
C4.NEED_MORE_INFORMATION: A case without the legal basis.
C4.FAIL: Wrong provisions, or unrelated to corporate income tax.

C5.PASS: A professional conclusion the expert made and is responsible for.
C5.NEED_MORE_INFORMATION: Took part, but it is unclear who concluded.

expertPolicy.title: Expert policy
expertPolicy.help: Values used when reviewing expert eligibility and competency. Changes apply to later decisions right away, without a restart; past decisions keep the values in force when they were made. Every change needs a reason and is kept in the history.

MinYearsExperience.label: Minimum years of experience
MinYearsExperience.help: Threshold of the tax and accounting experience criterion. Declared experience below it cannot pass. Default {{defaultValue}} years; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

ReapplyNotEligibleDays.label: Wait after not eligible
ReapplyNotEligibleDays.help: Days an expert waits before a new application after a Not eligible decision. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

ReapplyCompetencyFailDays.label: Wait after failing competency
ReapplyCompetencyFailDays.help: Days an expert waits before registering the same service again after failing the competency review. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

ReviewClaimHours.label: Review hold period
ReviewClaimHours.help: Hours a reviewer keeps a claimed review. Without a decision by then it returns to the shared queue; time spent waiting for the expert does not count. Default {{defaultValue}} hours; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

MaxInformationRequests.label: Maximum information rounds
MaxInformationRequests.help: How many times a reviewer may ask the expert for more information on one review, for both eligibility and competency. When they are used up the reviewer must pass or fail. Default {{defaultValue}}; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

ReviewSlaDays.label: Review waiting limit
ReviewSlaDays.help: Days a review may wait for a reviewer before the queue highlights it. A warning only; nothing happens automatically. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

FinalApprovalDays.label: Final approval limit
FinalApprovalDays.help: Days the final approval may take after the competency review passes. Past that, the record is marked red and moved to the top of the queue; it is never approved automatically. Experts see the expected result date from this limit. A change applies to how due dates are counted from the moment it is saved. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

PricingMinFee.label: Minimum price
PricingMinFee.help: The lowest price an expert may set per request. Applies from the next price save; prices already set are not changed. Default {{defaultValue}} VND; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

PricingMaxFee.label: Maximum price
PricingMaxFee.help: The highest price an expert may set per request; not below the minimum price. Applies from the next price save. Default {{defaultValue}} VND; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

TurnaroundMinDays.label: Shortest delivery time
TurnaroundMinDays.help: The fewest days an expert may promise to deliver in. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

TurnaroundMaxDays.label: Longest delivery time
TurnaroundMaxDays.help: The most days an expert may promise to deliver in; not shorter than the shortest. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

PlatformFeeNoticeDays.label: Platform fee change notice
PlatformFeeNoticeDays.help: Minimum days between scheduling a platform fee change and it taking effect, for raises and cuts alike. Default {{defaultValue}} days; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

PriceChangeWarningPercent.label: Price change warning
PriceChangeWarningPercent.help: When an expert changes the price by more than this against the old price, the confirmation shows a red warning. Warning only, never blocks. Default {{defaultValue}}%; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

NearThresholdExtraYears.label: Near-threshold experience margin
NearThresholdExtraYears.help: Extra years above Minimum years of experience that still raise a screening check for manual verification. Default {{defaultValue}} year(s); allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

ScreeningAiTimeoutMinutes.label: AI screening timeout
ScreeningAiTimeoutMinutes.help: Maximum minutes an AI screening run may wait before marking as failed for manual review or retry. Default {{defaultValue}} minutes; allowed {{min}}–{{max}}.

expertPolicy.outOfRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
expertPolicy.reasonPlaceholder: For example: per the policy decision of …

errors.POLICY_CHANGED: Someone else just changed these values. They have been reloaded; check them and save again.
errors.POLICY_RANGE_INVERTED: A minimum may not be greater than its maximum (price).
errors.POLICY_EXPECTED_VALUE_REQUIRED: The current value is missing. Reload the page and try again.
errors.POLICY_SETTING_OUT_OF_RANGE: A value is outside its allowed range.

errors.POLICY_REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason can be at most 1000 characters.
errors.UNKNOWN_POLICY_SETTING: Unknown setting. Reload the page and try again.

review.title: Application review
review.help: Thresholds and deadlines reviewers and admins follow for eligibility, competency and final approval.

reapply.title: Reapply waiting time
reapply.help: Days an expert must wait before applying again after a failed result.

pricing.title: Service pricing
pricing.help: Limits experts must respect when setting service prices, and rules for price or platform fee changes.

expertPolicy.rangeInverted: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.
expertPolicy.discardBody: The values go back to what is in effect. Nothing has been saved.
expertPolicy.reasonMin: At least {{count}} characters, saying why the change is needed.

claim.waitingForExpert: waiting for the expert to supplement
claim.help: One reviewer per review at a time. Claim a review before assessing it; others can only read it. It stays yours while more information is requested and comes back to you when the expert resubmits. If you do not decide within the hold period (set by a System Admin), it returns to the shared queue.

history.claimAfterExpiry: Claimed the review after {{previous}}'s hold expired
history.release: Returned the review to the queue

errors.REVIEW_CLAIMED: Another reviewer just claimed this review. Reloaded to show who holds it.
errors.REVIEW_NOT_CLAIMED: You no longer hold this review (the hold expired or it was handed on). Reloaded the review.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

claim.releaseConfirm: Release this review? Unsubmitted results are not kept.

assignments.title: Review assignments
assignments.help: Open eligibility and competency reviews with the reviewer holding each one. Hand a review to another reviewer when the holder is away or to balance the work; the reason is kept in the review history.

dialog.title: Reassign {{name}}'s review
dialog.reviewerHelp: Lists reviewers who have opened the review queue. A review cannot go to its own expert.
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the current reviewer is on leave until the end of the week

errors.CLAIM_REASSIGN_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the reassignment.
errors.CLAIM_REASSIGN_REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason can be at most 1000 characters.
errors.REVIEWER_NOT_FOUND: Reviewer not found. They must open the review queue at least once.
errors.SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED: A review cannot be handed to its own expert.
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_IN_REVIEW: The review is no longer open. Reload the list.
errors.QUALIFICATION_NOT_IN_REVIEW: The review is no longer open. Reload the list.
errors.failed: Could not reassign. Please try again.

finalReturn.title: Returned at final approval
finalReturn.help: A System Admin returned this record because the result does not state its grounds clearly. Review it again and state the grounds; each return adds one more information round. The expert is not told about the return.

rounds.label: Information round {{used}}/{{max}}
rounds.last: This is the last information round
rounds.lastHelp: All {{max}} information rounds allowed by the policy were used. Pass or fail on the evidence at hand.

serviceAccess.suspendBody: {{name}}'s {{service}} is hidden from the Marketplace and takes no new requests. Cases in progress continue; the expert's other services are not affected.
serviceAccess.reinstateBody: {{name}} can provide {{service}} again. The decision is recorded in the history.
serviceAccess.noteMissing: Enter a reason for the suspension.

operationsUnavailable.title: Not connected yet
operationsUnavailable.body: This feature is not open yet. Figures will appear here once it is.

areas.disputes: This account has no permission to resolve disputes, so the arbitration queue is not shown here.
areas.escrow: This page will show money held until acceptance, payouts to experts and refunds to clients. No data until payments are connected.
areas.pricing: This page will show price ranges per template group and experts priced outside them. The general price range is currently set on the Expert policy page.
areas.users: The account list and lock or password-reset actions are not on the server yet. New and total user counts on the Overview come from statistics, so they still show.

next.users: See user counts on the Overview

excuseRequests.title: Violation excuse requests
excuseRequests.help: Experts ask to have a violation excused for force majeure (illness, bereavement, disaster, a platform outage), with a reason and evidence files. An excused violation stops counting; the case's money split does not change. At most 2 excuses per expert in 90 days.
excuseRequests.search: Search by expert, email or case code
excuseRequests.limitReachedHint: This expert has used both excuses for the last 90 days; this request can only be declined.

payouts.title: Payouts to experts
payouts.noAccount: The expert has no default account
payouts.attemptsExhausted: Failed {{count}} times. The expert must add another account and have it verified before it is sent again.

result.PENDING: The payout has not been sent.
result.PROCESSING: Sent through PayOS, waiting for the bank.
result.FAILED: The transfer was refused; the reason is shown in the table.

errors.notTransferable: This payout is already being transferred or has been paid.
errors.noAccount: The expert has no bank account to receive this payout.
errors.onHold: This payout is still in its 7-day hold after settlement and cannot be sent yet.
errors.attemptsExhausted: This payout has no retries left. The expert must add another account and have it verified.
errors.unavailable: No answer from PayOS yet (payout channel not configured or PayOS not responding). Use Check result in a few minutes.
errors.sessionCheck: Your session could not be checked; try again later.
errors.notVerified: The expert's bank account is not verified yet. Review it under Verify payout accounts first.

bankReview.title: Verify payout accounts
bankReview.help: Money only goes to verified accounts. Enter the bank and account number in a banking app to see the real holder name, then compare it with the expert's registered name. Verify when they match, otherwise reject with a reason. Each account is reviewed once, and you cannot review your own.

errors.alreadyReviewed: This account has already been verified or rejected.
errors.selfReview: You cannot review your own account.
errors.notFound: Account not found; the expert may have removed it.
errors.reason: Enter a rejection reason (up to 500 characters).
